full_page.content:
1949, March 23
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
3/23/49 Blessed be God in all His designs !
God bless you Mrs. John O'Flaherty -- you and yours.
Dear Mrs. O'Flaherty:
Many thanks for your kind favor of just a month ago -- duly received and noted.
I've had it right here waiting to get a chance to write worth while and it just seems such a time never comes; I do hope that by this time Mr. Flaherty is quite o.k. and that Tommy continues to like it in the Seminary more and more. Indeed that is a grace initself for which we should never cease praying viz. to be grateful for and love the vocation to which, in His great mercy God has called us. This of course really applies to every vocation, for after all, What a privilege to serve God in even the least capacity! -- Nay even as an irrational as the flowers and the birds! and the bees that praise the Lord providing for man. . .!
Priased be Jesus and Mary! Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in possession of : Mrs. Elizabeth O'Flaherty 1382 Nottingham Grosse Pte., MI. 48230
